raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "vw-executor" %}
{% set version = "0.3.3" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/vw-executor-{{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 71b270008f4665b7569e0c24b05f3320eafb6e0ea23a1d5192f34a3177453476
  - url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VowpalWabbit/data-science/master/LICENSE.txt
    fn: LICENSE.txt
    sha256: c66cc3b0905f9b3da5162ef22b0aa1925dbc13603cdf012d9e0109a034155f1b

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 2

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
  run:
    - pandas >=1.0.0
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - tqdm >=4.0.0
  run_constrained:
    - vowpalwabbit >=8.10.0

test:
  imports:
    - vw_executor
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - vowpalwabbit
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/VowpalWabbit/data-science
  summary: Helpers for driving vw execution from python
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - xhochy
